# Jeremiah 19 — Disagreement Log

## 19:10 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "Then-you-shall-break the-flask before-the-eyes-of the-men who-go with-you, |
| LOGOS | "Then you shall break the flask in the sight of the men who go with you, |
| PNEUMA | "Then break the jar in front of the men who came with you |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 19:5 (overlap: 4%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-they-built the-high-places-of Baal to-burn their-sons in-the-fire [as]-burnt-offerings to-Baal, which I-did-not-command and-did-not-speak, and-[it]-did-not-come-up upon-My-heart. |
| LOGOS | And they have built the high places of Baal to burn their sons in the fire as burnt offerings to Baal, which I did not command or decree, nor did it come into My mind. |
| PNEUMA | They have built pagan shrines to Baal and there they burn their own children as sacrifices to Baal. I never commanded such a horrible thing — it never even crossed My mind! |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
